Residual hazard for VM-side runners: prefer a durable write channel for watermark files until the exec channel stabilizes.

Run creation measured ~2,100/h average with bursts of 100 runs/19s (69% issue_comment, 20% workflow_run, 11% push - build seat sample, #5219 receipt c.6823781174): every comment wakes every comment-subscribed workflow, and each created run's reads draw the same bucket, so the wall arrives fleet-wide across unrelated workflows at once (cluster 2026-11-12T10:51-10:52Z; annotation of record on collect-peer-responses 11:09Z, request DC83:1898F0). Bucket separation proven at the wall: PAT core healthy (289-335/5,000) and the Swarm App installation idle (1/12,500) in the same window (main firsthand 11:04-11:12Z).

cause.lane_behavior: The #5219 re-fix audit doc (PR #5248, docs/ops/rate-limit-refix-audit.md) read all 51 in-window 'API rate limit exceeded for installation' annotations as the Swarm App installation bucket and stamped mint-effectiveness PROVEN. The annotation string does not discriminate buckets - the shared GITHUB_TOKEN is itself an installation token and produced the identical string in this episode's morning cluster - and the doc carried no per-job token identification and no Swarm /rate_limit read covering the window; it also stated the Swarm limit as 5,000/h against the 12,500/h limit of record.
cause.pattern: annotation-string attribution without per-job token identification

findings.improvement: Attribution standard for register/audit work (quota-specialist adjudication 2026-11-12 on QDesk flag #5219 c.6827401300; evidence: the 51-hit annotation sweep + per-workflow token binding at the window commit b0d647c231ee): an installation-limit annotation is attributed by the failing job's token binding in its workflow file, never by the string alone. Ruling on the 51 hits: MIXED - 50 on the shared github_token (7 workflows carrying no Swarm mint: Agent PR Jules Handoff 10, Gemini review after peers 8, game-development dispatch 4, Agent review to auto Jules 2, RECON INTEL discovery 1, PR scope guard 1, Advisory CodeQL analysis 24 annotations on internal default-token calls) and 1 on the Swarm installation (collect-peer-responses, run 43227930089, 13:48:11Z - the migrated job's only installation-token call is its Swarm-bound collect step). Swarm-token workflows ran 1,936x in-window with exactly that 1 hit, so the Swarm bucket was at most momentarily exhausted; the systemic exhaustion was the shared token. The re-fix audit doc's root-cause section requires a correction leg (the all-Swarm claim, the 5,000/h figure, and mint-effectiveness PROVEN).
